notes.title: 10-Second Rule Ver2.0 Released! Escape Restarts
notes.content:
【Ver2.0 Update Details】

Several new stages added

New traces of past "test subjects"

Enhanced and rebalanced gimmicks

Improved UI and effects

Various bug fixes

“The door opens after 10 seconds… and closes in 3.” That nerve-racking rule is back, and now even more intense.
Step into the updated test chambers and challenge your survival—again.
